parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of wood, forming the front panel of the cabinet. It is rectangular and attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: The cabinet door allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet and can be opened or closed to conceal or reveal the contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close, providing access to the cabinet interior.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet frame made of plywood, forming the structural body that supports the door and internal compartments.
parts.Functional_description: The frame provides structural integrity, supports the door, and defines the storage compartments within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed support structure for the cabinet door and shelves.
